# 人工智慧工業應用學分學程
元智大學人工智慧工業應用學分學程科目規劃表
Yuan Ze University Artificial Intelligence in Industrial Applications Program
Course Planning Table
115.04.29 一一四學年度第七次教務會議通過
Passed by the 7th Academic Affairs Meeting, Academic Year 2025, on April 29, 2026
一、教學目標 Teaching Objectives：
為配合協助政府的工業相關產業創新計畫，驅動產業發展量能，為因應這波人工智慧革命，本學分學程屬於人工智慧應用學分學程，主要給跨領域學生修習，因此課程設計從先修的統計開始，建議學生在修課之前仍需修習程式設計課程，接下來透過循序漸進的修課規劃，才能在工業上創新。
To support government-led industrial innovation initiatives and boost industrial development capacity in response to the ongoing AI revolution, this program—under the Industrial AI Applications Program—is primarily designed for cross-disciplinary students. The curriculum begins with statistics as a prerequisite, and it is recommended that students also take programming courses beforehand. A step-by-step learning progression is provided to equip students with the skills necessary for industrial innovation through AI.

三、學程證書授予標準Certificate Award Criteria：
有意修讀本學分學程之同學，請自行至個人Portal完成線上選課作業。Students intending to apply for this credit program shall submit an online application through their personal Portal accounts.
凡修畢本學分學程規定課程並累計修滿15學分者，請向AI中心提出申請；經審核通過後，授予「人工智慧工業應用學分學程」證書。Students who have accumulated 15 credits in this credit program may submit an application to the AI Center. Upon review and approval, a certificate for the Artificial Intelligence in Industrial Applications Program will be awarded.
凡修畢AI聯盟開設課程的3門及其他院系開設課程2門者，累計達5門課程者，得申請教育部頒發的證書；欲申請者請向AI中心提出申請，經審核通過後將授予證書。Students who have completed three courses offered by TAICA and two courses offered by other departments, for a total of five courses, may apply for a certificate issued by the Ministry of Education. Applicants shall submit their application to the AI Center; upon review and approval, the certificate will be awarded.
四、領域別 Fields of Study： 人工智慧 Artificial Intelligence
